description: This file defines the ArithmeticUtils class, providing static utility methods for advanced arithmetic operations such as addition, multiplication, factorial, binomial coefficients, GCD, LCM, and power functions, with overflow checks and specific handling for large numbers. It also includes methods for combinatorial and number theory calculations, some marked as deprecated in favor of other utilities.

classes.name: ArithmeticUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing extensive static methods for safe, overflow-checked arithmetic, combinatorics, and number theory operations.

methods.name: addAndCheck
methods.description: Adds two integers with overflow check, throws MathArithmeticException on overflow.

methods.name: addAndCheck
methods.description: Adds two longs with overflow check, throws MathArithmeticException on overflow.

methods.name: binomialCoefficient
methods.description: Calculates n choose k as a long, delegates to CombinatoricsUtils, deprecated.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientDouble
methods.description: Calculates n choose k as a double, delegates to CombinatoricsUtils, deprecated.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientLog
methods.description: Calculates the natural log of the binomial coefficient, delegates to CombinatoricsUtils, deprecated.

methods.name: factorial
methods.description: Computes n! as a long, delegates to CombinatoricsUtils, deprecated.

methods.name: factorialDouble
methods.description: Computes n! as a double, delegates to CombinatoricsUtils, deprecated.

methods.name: factorialLog
methods.description: Computes log(n!), delegates to CombinatoricsUtils, deprecated.

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two integers or longs with overflow checks.

methods.name: gcdPositive
methods.description: Calculates GCD of two positive integers using binary method.

methods.name: lcm
methods.description: Calculates least common multiple of two integers or longs.

methods.name: mulAndCheck
methods.description: Multiplies two integers or longs with overflow detection, throws exception on overflow.

methods.name: subAndCheck
methods.description: Subtracts two integers or longs with overflow check.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises an integer or long to a non-negative integer or long power with overflow check.

methods.name: isPowerOfTwo
methods.description: Checks if a long value is a power of two.
